title: Savor Cinema

services.name: Theater Rentals
services.desc: Located in the heart of downtown Fort Lauderdale, Savor Cinema is the perfect venue for a wide range of events. Its “old world” charm has a lot to offer. Built in 1926 as a church then later becoming the Vinnette Carroll Playhouse and now Savor Cinema. We have kept the wonders of old architecture and stained glass windows from the last century and modernized for a better entertainment experience for today’s audiences. The theater features 212 plush faux leathers covered rocker stadium seats (additional seating can be added to comfortably seat 234), a full proscenium stage 37 feet long by 20 feet deep, with a complete lighting system.
